summary: deref returns undefined after the implementation has cleared a dead weak target.

tests.name: result domain
tests.input: let x={}; const r=new WeakRef(x); const v=r.deref(); console.log(v===undefined||v===x)

tests.name: no deterministic gc assertion
tests.input: const x={}; const r=new WeakRef(x); console.log(typeof r.deref()==='object')
tests.expected_behavior: prints true while strong reference x is live
